title: Common K-flat roofs for ordinary tensor resolutions
statement: Every map of second complexes admits a common K-flat roof with quasi-isomorphic augmentations and a homotopy commutative comparison.

proof.text: Use the homotopy-category calculus of fractions to obtain a common refinement of the two complexes over the given map.

Resolve the refinement source by a K-flat complex and compose its augmentation with the refinement legs; two-out-of-three gives the quasi-isomorphisms and the refinement equality gives the displayed homotopy.

lean.statement: theorem native_ordinary_tensor_model_resolution_roof (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u}) : ∀ (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (g : Q ⟶ Q'), ∃ (K K' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (hK : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y K) (hK' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y K') (q : K ⟶ Q) (q' : K' ⟶ Q') (u : K ⟶ K'), QuasiIso q ∧ QuasiIso q' ∧ Nonempty (Homotopy (u ≫ q') (q ≫ g))
